text: Core courses Jurisprudence, Constitution, Criminal Law, Administrative Law, Law of Executive Accusation, Civil Law, Code of Civil Law, Commercial Law, International Private Law, International Economic Law, Criminal Procedural Law, Economic Law, Chinese Legal History, Law of Nations, Intellectual Property Law Objective This objective is to train students to obtain strong applied-oriented ability, so that students after graduation are able to work as lawyers, judges, prosecutors and legal professional personnel in administration institutions or enterprises. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Law is granted
